FACT_ID: sec04-F01 | anchor: A39
Sit upright with your back against the seat and your feet on the floor. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F02 | anchor: A39
Set the seat and mirrors for a clear surrounding view, easy pedal access and a comfortable steering reach with airbag space. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F03 | anchor: A39
Raise the seat enough to see the road, using a cushion if needed, without moving so far forward that steering is hindered. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F04 | anchor: A39
You should be able to switch between brake and accelerator easily while your heel stays on the floor. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F05 | anchor: A39
Position the steering-wheel top no higher than your shoulders and below your chin. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F06 | anchor: A39
Leave 10 inches between your chest and the steering wheel for the airbag, and avoid reclining the seatback. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F07 | anchor: A39
The head restraint should touch the back of your head above ear level. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F08 | anchor: A39
Set the inside rearview mirror to frame the rear window. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F09 | anchor: A39
Set a day-night mirror for the current light conditions to reduce glare from following headlights. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F10 | anchor: A39
Adjust rearview and side mirrors before starting to drive. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-F11 | anchor: A40
To set the left exterior mirror, rest your head against the closed left window and adjust until only a small part of the vehicle’s left rear edge is visible. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec04-F12 | anchor: A40
To set the right exterior mirror, lean right with your head directly below the inside rearview mirror and adjust until the right vehicle side is barely visible. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec04-F13 | anchor: A40
Exterior mirrors should provide the widest useful view to the sides and rear. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec04-F14 | anchor: A40
Fasten your safety belt, and ensure occupants use belts or appropriate child seats. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec04-F15 | anchor: A40
Belts reduce crash injury and death and help prevent occupants from being thrown out. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec04-F16 | anchor: A40
Belts help keep the driver behind the wheel during sudden stops or turns so control can be maintained. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec04-F17 | anchor: A40
In a collision an unbelted occupant keeps moving until striking something inside the stopped vehicle. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec04-F18 | anchor: A40
Belts help resist slouching and reduce the effort of remaining in the seat as the vehicle bounces or turns. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec04-F19 | anchor: A41
Buckle before starting the car because an emergency leaves no time to fasten the belt. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec04-F20 | anchor: A41
Wear the shoulder belt across your shoulder and chest, never beneath an arm or behind the back. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec04-F21 | anchor: A41
Wear the lap belt comfortably tight below the stomach and over the hips and hip bones. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec04-F22 | anchor: A41
Airbags provide added protection and work with safety belts; they do not replace wearing a belt. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec04-F23 | anchor: A41
Airbags and belts help prevent the head and upper body from striking the wheel or dashboard. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec04-F24 | anchor: A41
Consult the owner’s manual for information specific to the vehicle’s airbags. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> pdf-0041]

Misconceptions: airbags supplement belts instead of replacing them. [A41]
Mnemonic: position, mirrors, belts, child restraints.
Glossary: the lap belt rests below the stomach over the hip bones. [A41]
Dynamic facts: statistics and conflicting child-restraint boundary wording remain verification debt.
